label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP because rememberMeKey is generated using java.util.Random, which is cryptographically weak for session tokens. Alert 2 (java/xss) is FP because the sink writes rememberMe attributes derived from server-side constants (className) and Random, not user input.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness: rememberMeKey generated via java.util.Random.nextFloat() used for session token.
False positive XSS: Sink prints rememberMe attributes sourced from server-side generated cookieName (from className) and rememberMeKey (from Random), not user input.
